create_mllama_processor: create a MllamaProcessor instance with an image processor and tokenizer for multimodal text-image input
call_mllama_processor: call the MllamaProcessor to tokenize text and process images, returning input_ids, pixel_values, and cross_attention_mask
build_cross_attention_mask: build a cross-attention token mask for image tokens in the input sequence to define which tokens each image attends to
convert_sparse_cross_attention_mask: convert a sparse cross-attention mask representation to a dense 4D numpy array for model input
post_process_image_text_to_text: post-process generated model outputs by decoding tensors back to text strings with the tokenizer
